tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Sound navy. The anchor colour. Headings in light, the raised surface in dark, label colour on gold and sky.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Sound blue. Links and the primary button in light. Text on surface and surface-raised only (4.5:1 and 4.76:1), not on surface-band.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Sound deep blue. Hover and pressed state of blue fills. White on it is 7.7:1.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sound sky. Accent in dark, decorative fills in light. Never text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sound gold. One highlight per screen: a marker, a 'review' badge, the cover. Navy text on it (9:1). Never text itself.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Sound orange. Risk and scam signals as fills, dots and icons (3.6:1 on white, so never small text). Pair with a word.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Sound ice. Light tint for blocks and the header band.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is Sound's pale ice. Dark is a derived deep navy.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus and anything that must sit above the page. Used sparingly; Instinct prefers flat page sections.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: The top header band only. Text on it is ink or ink-body, never ink-muted or blue (both fall under 4.5:1 here in light).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and sections. Decorative only, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Serif headings and the header title, on surface, surface-raised and surface-band.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy and list text on every surface (13:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: List numerals, captions, the 'unverified' notes. On surface and surface-raised only (4.7:1 light); not on surface-band.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, primary button fill, active states. As text, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The one gold moment: a 'needs review' badge, a key number's underline.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: Risk dot, risk bar, alert icon. Always next to a word.

tokens.name: risk-text
tokens.usage: Risk wording, on surface, surface-raised and risk-soft (4.75:1+). Derived darker/lighter from Sound orange so text passes.

tokens.name: risk-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind risk-text in badges.

tokens.name: safe-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text in 'verified' badges.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset. 4.5:1 on light surfaces, 10:1 on dark.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Stop the loss before it leaves
styles.usage: Pitch title and the cover. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The centred product name in the header band.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings. Sentence case, no colon, no number.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Byline and date in the header band, joined by a middle dot.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Taken from the transcript you pasted.
styles.usage: The one or two lines under a section heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Members want speed, but the hard part is friction.
styles.usage: List rows and paragraphs. Generous leading is the style.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Speaker names are garbled and not verified.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding, tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between header meta and actions; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Lead to list; ordered-list numeral gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections. Whitespace, not rules, separates sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Sections, rows and the header band are square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs (Sound's most common radius).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Raised panels, when one is truly needed.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges only.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column; list rows run the full width with 216px side margins at desktop.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the surface-band header.
